invariants.rationale: Instant time is typically required as a valid commit identifier and is unlikely to be null.
The commit operation likely requires a non-null map of partition records to operate correctly.
A commit operation usually operates on at least one partition; calling with an empty map may be invalid or a no-op.
A commit instant time string is generally expected to be non-empty.
It is unlikely for commit instantTime to be used as a partition key; expressing this negative relationship may prevent misuse where the key space must be disjoint from commit IDs.
